corrections.smallestCorrection: apply the ToUnicode CMap in the anchor-capture module when extracting heading and label text

ownerDecision.question: Should the movant's own name be written into the caption of CC 6:12, as it is on the companion Nebraska forms in this shard?
ownerDecision.rectangle: (108,247,305,261) — the 'vs. ____, (your full name) Defendant.' caption slot on page 1
ownerDecision.observed: field-classification.json classifies 'Adult name' as 'manual' and production-field-map.json refuses it with 'classified_unwritable_by_role'. The caption of the filed Motion therefore carries no movant name, while the same participant's name is printed on page 2 under 'Printed Name'. The two companion Nebraska families in this shard resolve the identical caption slot the other way: NE:cc-6-11-form-en and NE:cc-6-11-2-form-en both bind their caption field 'defendant' to participant.full_legal_name and write it.
ownerDecision.whyThisIsNotAMechanicalCorrection: both readings are defensible — a caption name may be reserved for hand completion, or it may be participant-owned like every other instance of the same fact on the same document. The three Nebraska forms currently disagree with each other, and nothing in the classification records which reading is intended. Choosing for the owner would decide document ownership, which is outside a reviewer's authority.
